title: Four-item applicant checklist duplicated verbatim across email_client and form_view; second consecutive sweep PR required
evidence: email_client.gleam:245: `fn requirements_checklist_html() -> String {` containing `<> "\">A written reference from your employer, if you're working — or from a client, accountant, or business contact if you're self-employed."` (called at lines 347, 422, 480, 545). form_view.gleam view_prep_block: `"A written reference from your employer, if you\u{2019}re working \u{2014} or from a client, accountant, or business contact if you\u{2019}re self-employed.",` plus the identical landlord-ref / referee-details / 15-minutes items as separate string literals.
detail: The same four checklist items live as independent string literals in two modules (email HTML vs SSR). #573 and now this PR both had to edit the identical sentence in both places — drift cost is demonstrated, and a future ruling can silently land on only one surface.
recommended_fix: Hoist the four item strings into server/src/copy.gleam (existing copy home, e.g. checklist_items() -> List(String)); have requirements_checklist_html and view_prep_block render from it. Email bodies are UTF-8, so — escaping needn't block sharing.
